decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the change of use of the existing ancillary offices to an ancillary health suite for the guest house, would not harm neighbours' living conditions, would not harm the appearance of the building or the street scene and would not result in conditions prejudicial to highway safety. The proposal therefore accords with adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and T.1.4 (Car & cycle parking & servicing facilities for developments).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The health suite hereby approved shall only be used as a medical screening centre for purposes ancillary to the main use of the property at a guest house and for no other use within Use Class D1 of the Use Classes Order (2005).
description: Change of use from Hotel offices to medical suite for residents of the hotel
